title: A Rain Gauge Behind the Guesthouse
paras: People have measured rain for hundreds of years. At one small [[swiss|Swiss]] guesthouse, the practice began in 1932 with a glass jar. The owner, Marta, wanted to [[prepare|prepare]] for wet weather before taking visitors into the hills. Each morning, she went outside in her yellow [[raincoat|raincoat]]. She measured the water in the jar, then emptied it. Back inside, she wrote the number in her [[diary|diary]], beside notes about her day and how she felt.

The jar stood behind the kitchen, away from trees. Marta put [[sand|sand]] around its base to keep it steady. Her son helped her [[hold|hold]] it while she read the marks on its side. In 1938, a [[foreign|foreign]] visitor brought a proper rain gauge from France. Its narrow opening caught rain, and a glass tube showed the amount. Marta kept it beside her tea [[mug|mug]] until they found a safe place outside.

By the 1950s, a weather worker came by [[motorcycle|motorcycle]] each month to collect copies of the records. After Marta stopped working, her family continued the measurements. They also left a weather book at [[reception|reception]] for guests to read. The simple morning job became a family tradition, and the old jar stayed on a shelf.
zh: 人们测量雨量已有数百年的历史。在瑞士的一家小旅馆，这项工作始于1932年，当时用的是一个玻璃罐。店主玛尔塔想在带游客进山之前，为下雨天做好准备。每天早上，她都穿着黄色雨衣到外面去。她测量罐里的水，然后将水倒掉。回到屋里，她把数字记在日记中，旁边还写着当天的事情和自己的感受。
玻璃罐放在厨房后面，远离树木。玛尔塔在罐子底部周围铺上沙子，让它保持稳固。她读罐子侧面的刻度时，儿子帮她拿住罐子。1938年，一位外国游客从法国带来了一个正规的雨量计。它通过狭窄的开口收集雨水，再用一根玻璃管显示雨量。在找到安全的室外摆放地点之前，玛尔塔一直把它放在自己的喝茶用的马克杯旁边。
到了20世纪50年代，每个月都有一名气象工作人员骑摩托车来收取雨量记录的副本。玛尔塔不再工作后，她的家人继续测量雨量。他们还在接待处放了一本天气记录簿，供客人阅读。这项简单的晨间工作成了家庭传统，而那个旧玻璃罐则一直保留在架子上。

q.s: Marta bought the glass jar in 1932.
q.why: 只说明1932年开始用玻璃罐，未说何时购买。

q.s: Marta's son helped her hold the jar.
q.why: 第二段明确说儿子帮她拿住玻璃罐。

q.s: The family stopped measuring rain when Marta stopped working.
q.why: 玛尔塔不再工作后，家人继续测量雨量。
